data.name: Xiomaris
data.long_meaning: In Greek, Xiomaris means 'God's gracious gift'. It is derived from the Greek words 'xenos' meaning 'stranger' or 'guest' and 'marios' meaning 'rejoice' or 'grace'. The name is also associated with the Greek goddess Xenia, who was the goddess of hospitality and guest-friendship.
